questions.q: Substance X has a high melting point. It does not conduct when solid but conducts when molten. What is X?
questions.why: Ions are fixed in the solid lattice but free to move when molten.

questions.q: How many electrons are shared between the two atoms in a nitrogen molecule, N₂?
questions.why: N₂ has a triple bond: three shared pairs, which is 6 electrons.

questions.q: Why is graphite used as a lubricant?
options: Its layers are held by weak forces and can slide over each other
Each carbon atom forms four strong covalent bonds
It has a low melting point
questions.why: Weak forces between the layers let them slide; delocalised electrons explain conduction, not lubrication.

questions.q: Explain why sodium chloride has a high melting point.
questions.model: It has a giant lattice with strong electrostatic attractions between oppositely charged ions, so a lot of energy is needed to overcome them.
points: strong electrostatic attraction between oppositely charged ions
a lot of energy needed to overcome them
